mechanism: Norethindrone is a progestin that antagonizes the estrogen-suppressing effects of anastrozole, an aromatase inhibitor used in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, reducing anastrozole's therapeutic efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if hormonal contraception is required in patients receiving anastrozole for breast cancer, use non-hormonal contraception or consider progestin-only methods with careful monitoring of anastrozole efficacy.
